members.name: Dr. Lavu Rathaiah
members.bio: Dr. Lavu Rathaiah is a visionary educational architect, philanthropist, and founder-chairman of the Vignan Group of Institutions. Over four decades, he has established more than 45 educational institutions educating over 50,000 students across South India. A pioneer in student-centered technical pedagogy, he conceptualized the establishment of Vignan TBI under DST's NIDHI scheme to transform university laboratories into vibrant commercial venture engines for grassroots innovators and rural youth.
qualifications: Founder & Chancellor, VFSTR (Deemed to be University)
Conferred Multiple National Lifetime Achievement Awards in Higher Education
members.initiatives: Spearheaded the allocation of 10,000+ sq.ft dedicated incubation space at Nagarjuna Bhavan and created the initial institutional seed endowment fund for student innovators.

members.name: Sri Lavu Sri Krishna Devarayalu
members.role: Vice-Chairman, Vignan Group & Member of Parliament
members.bio: Sri Lavu Sri Krishna Devarayalu is an influential public policy leader and Member of Parliament representing Andhra Pradesh. With an advanced academic background in media, communication, and governance, he serves as Vice-Chairman of Vignan Group, spearheading youth innovation ecosystems, regional industrial partnerships, and deep-tech venture incubation hubs connecting coastal Andhra with global venture corridors.
qualifications: Master’s Degree in Media & Communication Management
Member of Parliamentary Standing Committees on Education & Technology
members.initiatives: Championed central government funding approvals, industry-consortium alliances, and investor networks for deep-tech AgriTech and Biotech startups at Vignan TBI.

members.name: Prof. P. Nagabhushan
members.bio: Prof. P. Nagabhushan is an internationally acclaimed computer scientist, academic administrator, and former Director of IIIT Allahabad. An IEEE Fellow and Fellow of the Institution of Engineers, his seminal research in pattern recognition, dimensionality reduction, and cognitive computing spans more than 400 scientific publications. At Vignan, he provides overarching academic research governance to translate university patents into commercial startups.
qualifications: Ph.D. in Computer Science & Information Technology
Former Director, Indian Institute of Information Technology (IIIT) Allahabad
Fellow, IEEE; Fellow, Institution of Engineers (FIE); Fellow, IETE
members.initiatives: Established the Technology Transfer Office (TTO) and interdisciplinary research centers aligning university faculties with incubatee technical challenges.

members.name: Dr. M. S. Raghunathan
members.role: Registrar, VFSTR Deemed to be University
members.bio: Dr. M. S. Raghunathan oversees institutional governance, regulatory compliance, and university infrastructure enablement for Vignan TBI. With decades of executive experience in higher education management, he ensures seamless administrative synergy between university labs, intellectual property licensing, and incubator operations.
qualifications: Statutory Secretary to the Board of Management
members.initiatives: Streamlined single-window campus access passes, laboratory resource credits, and IP licensing frameworks for all admitted incubatee founders.

members.name: Prof. D. Vijaya Ramu
members.bio: Prof. D. Vijaya Ramu is the Principal Investigator and Project Director of Vignan TBI. A distinguished biotechnologist and Dean of Academics at VFSTR, he led the successful bid and establishment of the DST NIDHI inclusive TBI grant. He directs the 4 Centers of Excellence (Biotech, Renewable Energy, Waste Valorization, DeepTech) and mentors founders on bioprocess scaling and patent disclosures.
qualifications: Principal Investigator for DST NIDHI i-TBI Council Vadlamudi
Senior Professor and Dean of Academics, VFSTR
members.initiatives: Directs the technical evaluation panel for NIDHI-PRAYAS grants and guides clinical trials and pilot validations for agri-biotech cohort startups.

members.name: Prof. B. Nageswara Rao
members.bio: Prof. B. Nageswara Rao is the Co-Principal Investigator of Vignan TBI, driving technical infrastructure development, hardware prototyping labs, and clean energy pilot testbeds. With deep expertise in mechanical design and energy systems, he bridges academic engineering faculties with early-stage hardware founders.
qualifications: Ph.D. in Mechanical / Energy Systems Engineering
members.initiatives: Supervises the Central Instrumentation Facility (CIF) and maker-space machinery, ensuring 24/7 access for incubatees developing physical prototypes.

members.name: Mr. Sandeep S
members.bio: Mr. Sandeep S is the Chief Executive Officer of Vignan TBI, leading cohort acceleration, investor syndication, and national incubator partnerships. An experienced venture builder and startup accelerator operator, he has facilitated over ₹10 Crores in non-dilutive grants, seed rounds, and corporate pilots for deep-tech innovators across India.
qualifications: 12+ Years Experience in Technology Commercialization & Venture Acceleration
members.initiatives: Formulated the 5-Stage Incubation Acceleration Roadmap, spearheaded the SPARK Innovation Summit, and built a network of 40+ accredited angel investors.

members.name: Mr. Abdul R. Owaisi
members.bio: Mr. Abdul R. Owaisi leads daily cohort operations, founder outreach, milestone reviews, and partner engagements at Vignan TBI. He coordinates national hackathons, bootcamp series, and incubation admission screening committees, ensuring early-stage founders receive timely operational and mentorship backing.
qualifications: Program Lead for DST NIDHI-EIR Cohorts
members.initiatives: Designed the cohort milestone tracking dashboard and coordinated over 25 founder bootcamps across coastal Andhra Pradesh.

members.name: Ms. A. Rose Evangiline
members.bio: Ms. A. Rose Evangiline oversees administrative governance, statutory grant documentation, financial audit dossiers, and founder facilitation at Vignan TBI. She coordinates seamless fund disbursement compliance for NIDHI-PRAYAS and EIR recipients.
focus_areas: Cohort Reporting to DST Govt. of India
members.initiatives: Standardized the compliance onboarding protocol for incoming cohort companies and manages the incubator's digital repository.

members.name: Mr. K. Pavan Kumar
members.bio: Mr. K. Pavan Kumar manages hardware maker-space operations, 3D printing suites, IoT test equipment, and instrumentation coordination. He provides hands-on technical guidance to student and faculty founders during MVP prototype assembly.
members.initiatives: Manages equipment runtime schedules across the 4 CoEs and assists founders in fabricating working physical demonstration units.

members.name: Dr. Bijay Kumar Sahu
members.bio: Dr. Bijay Kumar Sahu is one of India's leading authorities on Intellectual Property Rights (IPR), technology transfer, and patent commercialization. Heading the NRDC-WIPO Technology and Innovation Support Center, he advises national R&D institutions, premier universities, and deep-tech incubators on securing global patents.
qualifications: Head, NRDC Regional Office & WIPO TISC
Advisor to Dept. of Science & Technology and Ministry of MSME
members.initiatives: Conducts quarterly patent clinics for Vignan TBI startups, resulting in over 15 provisional patent filings by incubatees.

members.name: Dr. Suresh Bhagavatula
members.bio: Dr. Suresh Bhagavatula is an eminent professor of entrepreneurship and former Chair of NSRCEL at IIM Bangalore. His research on social capital, entrepreneurial networks, and venture scale models has guided hundreds of high-impact founders across India.
members.initiatives: Mentors founders on product-market fit validation and unit economic profitability prior to institutional venture capital rounds.

members.name: Mr. Dayakar Pushkar
members.bio: Mr. Dayakar Pushkar is a Silicon Valley investor, technology visionary, and Managing Director at Dallas Venture Capital (DVC). Having founded and successfully exited multiple enterprise tech startups, he guides Vignan TBI cohort companies on cross-border expansion, institutional funding, and enterprise sales.
qualifications: MS in Computer Engineering & Business Strategy
Managing Director, Dallas Venture Capital (USA & India)
Serial Entrepreneur with Successful Nasdaq / M&A Exits
members.initiatives: Serves on the Investment Pitch Board and connects high-performing Vignan TBI startups with global angel syndicates and institutional VCs.

members.name: Dr. Balareddy Bheemareddy
members.role: Founder & Managing Director, Provis Bio Labs
members.bio: Dr. Balareddy Bheemareddy is a serial life sciences entrepreneur and Managing Director of Provis Bio Labs. With extensive commercial experience in enzyme manufacturing, industrial fermentation, and microbial diagnostics, he guides bio-incubatees through pilot bio-refining and regulatory certifications.
qualifications: Founder & Managing Director, Provis Bio Labs Pvt Ltd
Holder of Multiple Industrial Bioprocess Patents
members.initiatives: Provides industrial trial-run access at Provis Bio Labs' pilot manufacturing facility for Vignan TBI biotech cohort ventures.

members.name: Mr. Ashish Garde
members.role: Director, MAGIC Incubator & Past President, MACCIA
members.bio: Mr. Ashish Garde is an industrial ecosystem pioneer, Director at MAGIC Incubator, and Past President of the Maharashtra Chamber of Commerce, Industry & Agriculture (MACCIA). He specializes in linking grassroots hardware startups with tier-1 automotive, manufacturing, and industrial supply chains.
members.initiatives: Facilitates commercial pilot procurement orders between established manufacturing MSMEs and Vignan TBI hardware innovators.

members.name: Ms. Ashwathy Venugopal
members.role: Lead, Headstart Andhra & KECTIL USA Fellow
members.bio: Ms. Ashwathy Venugopal is a passionate community builder, global youth leadership fellow, and regional lead for Headstart Network Foundation. She catalyzes grassroots startup communities, women-led ventures, and regional demo days connecting emerging founders with mentors.
qualifications: Fellow, KECTIL Youth Leadership Program (Atlanta, USA)
members.initiatives: Organizes monthly Founder Mixer nights, Women Startup Roundtables, and investor pitch clinics at Vignan TBI.

members.name: DST Representative
members.bio: The DST Representative serves as the governmental observer on the Vignan TBI Governing Council, ensuring strict adherence to NIDHI guidelines, milestone compliance, and national incubator benchmarking standards established by the Ministry of Science and Technology.
qualifications: Senior Scientist, Department of Science & Technology
Govt. of India Nominee on National Incubation Boards
Expert in National Science & Technology Entrepreneurship Policy
members.initiatives: Reviews bi-annual cohort graduation rates, financial allocations, and national intellectual property output of Vignan TBI.
